title: Weighted quadrant integral and density
statement: Let $0<\rho<1$ and $t\in\mathbb R$. The iterated integral over $z_1>t$ and $z_2>t$ of $(z_2-\rho z_1)(z_1-\rho t)$ times the density of a centered bivariate standard normal pair with correlation $\rho$ equals $(1-\rho^2)^2$ times that density evaluated at $(t,t)$.
